meta.source: Nathan's Google Drive: brain.rs (1760B) — HiveMindHost launcher
meta.note: Rust launcher for the HiveMind brain. The HiveMind_STANDALONE.jar (81KB, OhioKernel) exists in Drive/Brain/ — binary, noted not pulled.

mechanics.launch: locates Java (JAVA_HOME then PATH, Windows-friendly), spawns com.zenki.hivemind.Main from the JAR
mechanics.supervise: is_alive() via try_wait — the host watches the brain's process

system_role: Pattern for brain supervision: the Brain's maintainers are watched processes with liveness checks, not fire-and-forget threads.
